claims.text: Stop hunting is perceived negatively at the retail trader level.
claims.evidence: Is there something called stop hunting that takes place in the trading world? It's always looked upon as negative certainly at the retail trader level.

claims.text: Institutional traders buy good levels, while many retail traders wait for confirmation before entering.
claims.evidence: Institutional traders are taught from their first day that they buy good levels or they don't buy at all. Unfortunately, most retail traders will wait for some confirmation before they get in.
